package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type readinessRepositoryFake struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance domain.TaskInstance
	receipts map[string]string
	saves    int
}

func (repository *readinessRepositoryFake) GetInstance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if studentID != repository.instance.StudentID || instanceID != repository.instance.ID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.instance, nil
}

func (repository *readinessRepositoryFake) CreateOrLoadCommandReceipt(_ context.Context, idempotencyKey, instanceID, commandType, digest string) (bool, error) {
	key := instanceID + ":" + commandType + ":" + idempotencyKey
	if previous, ok := repository.receipts[key]; ok {
		if previous != digest {
			return false, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		return false, nil
	}
	repository.receipts[key] = digest
	return true, nil
}

func (repository *readinessRepositoryFake) SaveInstance(_ context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	repository.saves++
	instance.Version++
	repository.instance = instance
	return instance, nil
}

type readinessPlannerFake struct {
	ports.LearningRouteProvider
	byKey map[string]domain.LearningReadinessReceipt
	input ports.ReconcileLearningReadiness
	ready bool
	calls int
	wrong bool
}

func (planner *readinessPlannerFake) ReconcileReadiness(_ context.Context, input ports.ReconcileLearningReadiness) (domain.LearningReadinessReceipt, error) {
	planner.calls++
	planner.input = input
	if receipt, ok := planner.byKey[input.IdempotencyKey]; ok {
		return receipt, nil
	}
	receipt := domain.LearningReadinessReceipt{Schema: "practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1", ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091",
		TaskInstanceID: input.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: input.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: input.TaskRevisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: input.RevisionDigest, RouteID: input.RouteID, RouteDigest: input.RouteDigest, StepID: input.StepID,
		Decision: "NOT_READY", LearnerStateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		MasteryPolicyVersion: domain.LearningReadinessMasteryPolicyV1, ObservedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	if planner.ready {
		receipt.ID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000092"
		receipt.Decision = "READY"
	}
	if planner.wrong {
		receipt.TaskRevisionID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099"
	}
	planner.byKey[input.IdempotencyKey] = receipt
	return receipt, nil
}

func TestReconcileStepReadinessUsesPlannerReceiptAndPersistsMonotonicTransition(t *testing.T) {
	instance := readinessTestInstance()
	repository := &readinessRepositoryFake{instance: instance, receipts: make(map[string]string)}
	planner := &readinessPlannerFake{byKey: make(map[string]domain.LearningReadinessReceipt)}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Planner: planner, Now: func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
	keyNotReady := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010"
	first, status, err := runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, "checkpoint-one", keyNotReady)
	if err != nil || status != 200 || first.Receipt.Decision != "NOT_READY" || first.Instance.Steps[0].Status != "LEARNING_REQUIRED" {
		t.Fatalf("NOT_READY result = (%+v, %d, %v)", first, status, err)
	}
	replay, status, err := runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, "checkpoint-one", keyNotReady)
	if err != nil || status != 200 || replay.Receipt.ID != first.Receipt.ID || planner.calls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("same-key replay = (%+v, calls=%d, %d, %v)", replay, planner.calls, status, err)
	}
	planner.ready = true
	keyReady := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011"
	ready, status, err := runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, "checkpoint-one", keyReady)
	if err != nil || status != 200 || ready.Receipt.Decision != "READY" || ready.Instance.Steps[0].Status != "AVAILABLE" || repository.saves != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("READY result = (%+v, saves=%d, %d, %v)", ready, repository.saves, status, err)
	}
	if planner.input.TaskRevisionID != instance.TaskRevisionID || planner.input.RouteID != instance.LearningRoute.ID || planner.input.StepID != "checkpoint-one" {
		t.Fatalf("Planner did not receive exact frozen identity: %+v", planner.input)
	}
	if repository.instance.Steps[0].ReadinessReceipt == nil || repository.instance.Steps[0].ReadinessIdempotencyKey != keyReady {
		t.Fatalf("readiness receipt was not persisted with step: %+v", repository.instance.Steps[0])
	}
}

func TestReconcileStepReadinessRejectsWrongPlannerIdentityAndKeyReuse(t *testing.T) {
	instance := readinessTestInstance()
	repository := &readinessRepositoryFake{instance: instance, receipts: make(map[string]string)}
	planner := &readinessPlannerFake{byKey: make(map[string]domain.LearningReadinessReceipt), wrong: true}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Planner: planner}
	key := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
	_, status, err := runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, "checkpoint-one", key)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDependency) || status != 503 || repository.saves != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong Planner identity = (%d, %v), saves=%d", status, err, repository.saves)
	}
	planner.wrong = false
	_, status, err = runtime.ReconcileStepReadiness(context.Background(), instance.StudentID, instance.ID, "checkpoint-two", key)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrIdempotency) || status != 409 {
		t.Fatalf("same key for different step = (%d, %v), want idempotency conflict", status, err)
	}
}

func readinessTestInstance() domain.TaskInstance {
	return domain.TaskInstance{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
		TaskRevisionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		Status: domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, LearningRoute: domain.LearningRouteReceipt{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
			RouteDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"},
		Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "checkpoint-one", Required: true, Status: "LEARNING_REQUIRED"}, {ID: "checkpoint-two", Required: true, Status: "LEARNING_REQUIRED"}}}
}
